# Hue / saturation

Rotates hues, scales saturation and lifts or lowers lightness in OKLCH, a perceptual space, so a hue shift does not make yellows glow or blues go dark. Colorize paints everything one hue.

<EffectDemo effect="hue-saturation" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { hueSaturation } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/hue-saturation';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(hueSaturation({ preset: 'shifted' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.hue = 0`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Type    | Default | Range        | Description                                                  |
| ---------------- | ------- | ------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `hue`            | number  | `0`     | -180 – 180 ° | Rotates every hue.                                           |
| `saturation`     | number  | `0`     | -1 – 1       | Scales chroma; −1 removes color.                             |
| `lightness`      | number  | `0`     | -1 – 1       | Moves lightness toward black (negative) or white (positive). |
| `colorize`       | boolean | `false` |              | Replace every hue with one color, keeping lightness.         |
| `colorizeHue`    | number  | `220`   | 0 – 360 °    | Colorize: the hue to use.                                    |
| `colorizeChroma` | number  | `0.08`  | 0 – 0.3      | Colorize: the chroma (colorfulness) to use.                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset        | Settings                                                                        |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `shifted`     | `hue: 45`                                                                       |
| `desaturated` | `saturation: -0.7`                                                              |
| `cyanotype`   | `colorize: true`, `colorizeHue: 235`, `colorizeChroma: 0.1`                     |
| `rose`        | `colorize: true`, `colorizeHue: 350`, `colorizeChroma: 0.07`, `lightness: 0.05` |

Apply one with `hueSaturation({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/hue-saturation`, including the shared effect runtime.
